object.attr: as implemented: the release workflow attaches SHA256SUMS.txt (INSTALL.md, Build in CI). It detects a damaged download; a signature (MELLON-GUI-SRS-191) or an attestation (MELLON-GUI-SRS-192) would detect a replaced one (review Q78, failure analysis change 30).
object.description: Each published release of Mellon shall carry the SHA-256 checksum of the release's Windows installer.
